tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rang gi skyes pa'i rabs kyi gtam brjod pa bsil zer 'od kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rang gi skyes pa'i rabs kyi gtam brjod pa bsil zer 'od kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo| |dri med btso ma gser gyi mdog /mtshan dpe bye bas gzi 'od 'bar// mnyam med thub dbang mchog khyod kyi// zhabs rdul cha shas spyi bor len| |dmar ser rtags kyi bla gos lhab lhub 'chang*/ thub pa'i chos kun smra ba'i spobs pa can// 'jigs med chos kyi rgyal po bdag gi blo| |shākya mchog ldan bdag yid rol par mdzod// blo gros spobs pa mchog sbyin thun mtshams li khri'i mdangs// mkhyen rab ral gri stong phrag brgya pa'i pustaka 'dzin cing*// sna tshogs rgyan mdzes zur phud lnga ldan gzhon nu'i sku// 'jam dbyangs bla mas 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i snang ba stsol// gang zhig dad ldan blo yi ku mud tshal// rgyas par bya phyir bdag gi skye ba'i phreng*// bsil zer phyogs brgyar spro ba 'dir shar tshe// mos ldan tshogs rnams dad pa'i gzu 'doms dang*// bar ma rnams kyi nyams mtshar bzhad gad rgyu// dregs ldan rnams kyi rang 'dod ku re'i gnas/ /blo mug rnams kyi tshul min nga ldan tshul// de phyir yi ge'i shing rta la drangs nas// ngag 'jam smra ba'i rdza rnga rdung bzhin du// tshig don 'brel gtam dga' ston 'di na'o// 1 de yang ston pa shākya'i dbang po 'jig rten du byon pa'i dus bram ze'i rigs gtsang mar skyes shing thams cad yod smra'i lugs su bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i ming bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin rab tu bzang por btags/ slar yang dben par bsam gtan bsgoms pas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob ste lo brgyad cu rtsa bdun lon nas mya ngan las 'das so/ /mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i dus/ /bram ze'i rigs las sgra gcan 'dzin// sde snod rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son// dgra bcom 'bras bu mngon byas so// zhes so| | 2 rgya gar dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du slob dpon padma spyod pa mdzad pa'i mtshan shanta rakṣi tar grags pa'i tshe/

de'i slob ma gdol pa'i rigs can a bha ya singha zhes bya bar gyur cing gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs te sbyor sgrol gyi lam la brten nas tshe lo yun ring zhig thub bo// gdol ba'i 'jigs med seṅge tshe// shanta rakṣi ta drung du// zab lam sbyor sgrol nyams su blangs/ /gsang sngags chos mdzod bzung zhes thos/ /zhes so// 3 rgya gar byang phyogs gaṅgā dang nye ba'i char bram ze chags ldan gyi bu khye'u dga' byed du gyur/ chung ngu nas gtsang sbra la gnas shing spyod pa'i rgyud nyams su blangs pas yang dag pa'i don yang rtogs/ slar yang nags su kha zas rags pa'i 'khri ba bcad de chu'i dka' thub tsam gyis lo sum cu so brgyad bsam gtan byas pa'i mthar rlung nad kyis dus byas so// kye ma khye'u dga' byed de// chu yi dka' thub tsam zhig gis// lo grangs bcu phrag gsum lhag par// rtse gcig ting 'dzin sgom par grags// zhes so// 4 byang puṣpa ha rir drang srong sūrya nā tha zhes bya ba gyur nas/ mgon po tshe dpag med la grub pa brnyes nas lo grangs brgya dang bdun cur bzhugs pa las re zhig rang gi slob ma arbhandha nā tha zhes bya ba dam log pas yid phyung ste 'das so// drang srong nyi ma mgon po khyod// 'chi med rdo rje'i sku grub kyang*| |dam log slob mas bshigs nus pa// las dbang rten 'brel mthu min nam// zhes so// 5 rgya gar zangs gling du nang pa'i rgyal po dpal dgyes kyi sras tha chung 'od mdzes zhes bya bar gyur nas rang lo bdun lon dus yab 'das te bcu gsum pa la rgyal sar dbang bskur zhing lo bcu gnyis ring srid bskyangs/ nyer lnga lon dus su mu stegs kyi rgyal po tsa na ka'i thod can dang 'thab pas rang phyogs rgyal pa la mu stegs pas ma bzod de/ rgyal po la kha zas dug can drangs pas dus byas so// zangs gling sa skyong 'od mdzes zhes// mnga' 'bangs chos bzhin skyong ba la// ma bzod dug can sbyor ba mkhan// mu stegs tshogs de ci ltar 'gyur// zhes so//

6 rgya gar byang phyogs utpala'i tshal du gdol pa'i rigs su skyes te nā lend+rar rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs te gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi tar gyur pa'i ming tsand+ra de war grags/ slar gnas chen de'i mkhan por dbang bskur te lo grangs bdun cu rtsa bdun du tshogs pa bskyangs shing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba cher byas so// paṇa chen lha'i zla ba zhes// smra mkhan lung dang rigs pa yis// dge 'dun 'dus sde nā lend+rar// thub bstan rdzogs ldan dus la'ang 'gran// zhes so// 7 rgya gar gyi yul gru zhig tu dmangs rigs su skyes te dur khrod mun pa drag po zhes bya bar phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa byas pa'i ming rakṣa tsaṇḍar grags te lo bdun nas lus ma bzhag par mkha' spyod du gshegs so// mun pa drag po zhes bya bar// phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod pa yis// gsal dwangs 'ja' tshon gang gi lus// spros med nam mkha'i dbyings su thim// zhes so// 8 gnyan lo dar ma grags kyi slob ma rā dza uttam sā dha na zhes bya bar gyur/ mgon po zhal bzhi pa bsnyen pas grub pa brnyes pa yin yang*/ gzhan gyi byad kha drag po'i rkyen byas nas rang lo nyer brgyad la 'das so// skad gnyis smra bas legs bskyangs bu// 'jigs med zhal bzhi'i grub brnyes kyang*// phal rgol byad kyis tshugs par bstan// bslu med rten 'brel ma yin nam// zhes so// 9 bod yul dbus phyogs su grub thob me long rdo rje zhes bya bar gyur cing dar ma yun ring bar sgrub pa mdzad de lus ma bzhag par mkha' spyod du gshegs so// theg mchog sngags kyi nye lam zab mo yis// rnam smin sgyu lus 'ja' tshon ltar byas nas| |me long chos dbyings nam mkhar gshegs pa la// grub thob me long rdo rje mi zer ram// zhes so// 10 rgya gar lho phyogs bhaṅga lar rgyal po legs byin zhes bya bar gyur cing rang gi yi dam thugs rje chen po la byas te bsnyen/

slar li gser las thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi sku 'dra bzhengs te/ bod du bskur ba dus phyis ra 'dzab lha khang du 'dug pa nga rang gis ngos len bgyis te gdan drangs pa deng sang gtsang mchog grub gling gi rten gtsor bzhugs so// lho phyogs rgyal po legs byin des/ /gangs can lha gcig spyan ras gzigs| |yin pas 'di mchod zhes bskul phyir/ /sku rten bod du bskur bar grags/ /zhes so// 11 rgya gar nub phyogs su rgyal rigs su skyes te bstan pa'i sgor zhugs mkhas pa paṇḍi tar gyur pa'i ming dharma man zhes grags te 'phags yul du 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba byas/ de nas bod du 'ongs nas lo kha yar thos bsam gyi sgron me sbar te slar rgya gar du log snyam yang*/ rten 'brel gyis bod du 'das pa'i gdung yang deng sang spras kyi sha ba 'bum par mchod rten gyi nang na yod/ thos bsam sgom pas 'phags yul du// bstan pa'i bya ba cher bgyis nas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bod khams kyi// blo gros gsal mdzad chos kyi yid// ces so// 12 rgya gar ma ga dhar bram ze'i rigs las bstan pa la bsnyen par rdzogs/ paṇḍi ta shin tu mkhas pa zhig tu gyur nas rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po byas pa'i ming dharma mā lā zhes grags so/ /mkhyen pas gsung rab rgya mtsho khong chud nas// yongs 'dzin du mas thub pa'i rgyal tshab tu// dbang bskur chos kyi phreng ba zhes bya bar// snyan pa'i rol mos phyogs kyi 'khor lo gang*// zhes so// 13 gtsang rong du gsang sngags rnying ma'i rnal 'byor pa lha rje gnubs chung gi slob ma bande tshul khrims zhes bya ba zhig tu gyur kyang rang gar skyabs 'gro smar ba tsam las thos bsam sgom pa la brtson pa cher med do| |drag sngags dbang bskur dam pa yi// zhabs pad bsten mkhas tshul khrims ming*// nang gi rnal 'byor zab mo las// gzhan 'du yong ba ma gyur skad// ces so//

14 yul dbus su khu ston g.yung drung zhes bya bar gyur cing ston pa'i gzhung lugs dang rig pa smra ba la 'gran zla med/ jo bo rje bod du phebs pa'i dus bkur sti bzang pos bsten/ de nyid kyis gdams pa zab mo'i mdzod bzung zhing mya ngan las 'da' khar yang khu ston bstan pa'i bdag por 'os pas 'di khyer zhes thub pa gser gling ma gnang bar grags so// dī paṃ ka ra ma dros klu dbang las// zab don snying po chu bo brgya 'bab pa// blo gros bum pa bzang por 'dzin mkhas de// bod yul 'di na khu ston chen po yin// zhes so// 15 yar klung phyogs su phyug po zhig gi bur skyes te bstan pa la rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i ming gu ṇa ma ti zhes btags te/ bsam gtan sgom pa gtso bor byas pas rang mgo thon tsam las phrin las cher ma byung ngo*// yar klung sa yi thig le der// bslab gsum 'dzin pa'i dge slong zhig /bsam gtan sgom par blo gzhol tshe// yon tan blo gros ming du 'bod// ces so// 16 rngod kyi sribs phyogs su sngags pa rdo rje grags pa zhes par gyur nas yi dam du khro chu bsten zhing bsgrubs pas grub kyang phrin las cher ma byung zhing tshe lo drug cu tham pa la 'phos so// mdo khams rngod kyi dkyil 'khor du// khro chu rdo rje'i gar bsgyur zhing*// drag sngags me yis log 'dren dpung*// thal bar sreg pa'i rig sngags 'chang*// zhes so// 17 bal yul du bal po ba su dha ra'i slob ma hūm̐ mdzad rdo rje zhes bya bar gyur nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bsgrubs pas grub ste zhal mthong zhing sdom 'byung sogs la mkhas par sbyangs shing slob ma kha yar la man ngag bstan pas phan thogs par byung*/ lha gnas 'phos 'dra'i bal yul der// dra ba sdom pa'i rnal 'byor pa// hūm̐ mdzad rdo rjer zhes bya de// bla med rgyud sde'i mnga' dbang phyug /ces so//

18 bla ma gnam kha'u pa'i slob ma grags pa ye shes zhes bya bar skyes nas bla ma de las dbang lung man ngag zhus te kha'u brag rdzong du bsgrubs pas gnyan mgon bran du khol nus pa byung*/ 'on kyang lo nyer bdun pa la tshe 'phos so// 'jigs byed nag po zhal bzhi pa// mngag gzhug lta bur bkol mkhas de// grags pa ye shes de las gzhan// yod na gang zhig 'dir smos shig /zhes so// 19 bsam yas su dge bshes tshul khrims legs grub zhes bya bar gyur nas rgya nag gsar rnying gi gtsug lag dang chos tshul thams cad la shin tu mkhas par gyur to// rgya nag gtsug lag chos tshul rnams// ji bzhin mkhyen nas ston mkhas de// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs mgon po rang*// mi yi zol bzung tshul khrims ming*// zhes so// 20 ngam shod du shāka mchog nyid dge bshes mchog gi dbang por gyur tshe bdag kyang ngam shod du skyes nas dge bshes de la bsnyen rdzogs zhus pas ming grags pa'i mchog ces btags te/ bla ma'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du sgrub nus pa zhig go// rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam thar bzhin// bshes gnyen dam pa'i bka' gang zhig |nor bzang lta bu'i sgrub mkhas pa// grags mchog ces bya de yin no// zhes so// 21 rje phag mo gru pa'i sku tshe'i stod kyi slob ma gtsang rong ba rin chen chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ sgom ro gcig chen po mngon du gyur pa'i rtogs ldan zhig tu gyur cing*/ bla ma'i drin lan dang zhabs tog chos dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'jal lo// phag mo gru pa'i man ngag bcud| |rnam dpyod hub kyis ma lus 'thung*// ro gcig rtogs pa'i nyams ldan zhing*// sgrub pa'i srol 'dzin rin chen chos// zhes so// 22 skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar shīkṣa sa pa ri wā ra sba syottamapradzñā ka ra/ na mo dharmarbā ṇāṃ ko ṣa dha rāsti// mnyam med bla ma rin chen drung*// glang chen khyu las sa srung bu// dam chos mdzod 'dzin grwa 'bangs shig

|rgyu mtshan legs sbyar skad du gsal// zhes so// 23 dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa gsum par gyur nas ka tsan gnyis ka'i don khong du chud nas sgra mdo ka lā pa sogs kha yar bod du bsgyur ro// skad gnyis smra ba blo gros brtan// ka tsan gzhung lugs phul byung nas// thogs med blo gros phul byung bas// gzhon nu smin drug khengs pa bstungs// zhes so// 24 yang shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi tshe yang ka tsan dang swa ra swa ti dang ind+ra byā ka ra ṇa legs sbyar gyi gzhung 'bum phrag thugs la mnga' ste/ glegs bam uṇa sogs legs sbyar mang du bsgyur ro// brda sprod gzhung lugs rab 'byams gang*// smra mkhas shong ston lo tsā ste// uṇa sogs legs sbyar sgron me brgyas// bod yul mun pa bsal min nam// zhes so// 25 thub bstan gser mdog can dpa' bo rta dbyangs paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros zhes snyan pa'i ba dan sa gsum na yongs su gsal ba de la/ rab 'byams gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu smra ba la bsnyeng bral gyi slob ma bgrang ba'i yul las 'das pa byung ba'i nang du'ang*/ sras kyi thu bo dam pa don yod grub pa zhes bya bar gyur cing*/ paṇa chen de ltar la bsnyen par rdzogs zhing mdo rgyud man ngag ji snyed pa dag dang*/ khyad par chos kyi rje de nyid gyi bka' rtsom ma lus pa'i mdzod bzung zhing*/ phyis grub mtha'i rkang tshugs pa'i bstan bcos mang du mdzad de rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i slob ma mtha' yas pa thon zhing bstan pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur to// thub dbang spyan sngar 'jam dbyangs ltar// mdo sngags gzhung lugs mtha' yas pa'i// gcig car sgo brgya 'byed pa la// khyod dang mtshungs par srid 'dir gang*// zhes so// 26 'bri gung skyu ra'i rigs las bcu gnyis pa rdo rje rin chen du gyur cing*/ de skabs gling la nyams zhig chen po byung bas spro bar ma gyur kyang 'bad rtsol drag pos bstan pa rmang nas gsos/

mgon po beng bsgrubs pas des rgyan gyi dngos grub tu dpal gyi chas brgyad phul ba'i stag sham gyi ri mo da lta yang brla gong 'og dang pus mo la yod pa yin no// bzod dka' me yis rin chen gling sreg tshe// byams pa'i ga bur chu yis bsil byas nas// slar yang sgrub brgyud ge sar bzhad pa la// skyengs te rgol ngan sa 'og zhugs min nam// zhes so// 27 slar yang gzhu'i phyogs 'dir skyu ra'i gdung las dhyā naka ratna bi dza ya nā māsti// padmas lung bstan gzhu 'di ru// bstan dang 'gro la sman don du// slar yang gzugs sku'i rnam rol la// mtshan sbyar legs sbyar skad kyis so// zhes so// 28 yang yum dang rigs 'di rang las dhātundhu mi nā mākasha lo hāgni dzwa la nā ma asti/ 'di las 'phros pa'i skyes rabs kha yar zhar la rtogs par yang 'gyur ro// 'bri gung bka' brgyud dam chos 'dzin// yang dag don bzang smra bar byed// mang thos rig sngags 'chang ba po// rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i go 'phang bsgrubs// zhes so// 29 de nas skyu ra'i rigs las yum de nyid kyi sras mo zhig tu skyes lo kha yar 'tsho ba las/ rang gis bsam gzhig brtag dpyad byas pas bud med kyi lus 'dis rang don yang mi 'grub cing gzhan gdul bya mchog dman bar ma gang la'ang phan mi thog pa 'dug de las lus 'di spangs nas slar rigs 'di rang las skyes pa'i lus su skye bar bya'o snyam nas tshe 'phos so// rang gzhan don chen bsgrub pa la| |rgyu rkyen phun tshogs dgos so zhes// ston phyir 'chi 'phos skye ba rnams// bsam bzhin ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul gar// zhes so// 30 de ltar bu mo'i lus rten de bor nas slar yang da lta'i lus 'di 'bad pa drag pos blangs pa yin te/ yab chos kyi rgyal po dharma rā dza lakṣ+mī maṅgal shrī bha dra zhes yongs su grags pa'i sras kyi tha chung du shing mo lug la skyes shing*/

lo brgyad la yab chos kyi rgyal po mkha' spyod du gshegs/ lo bcu gsum la zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa chos kyi dbang phyug la dge tshul du bsgrubs shing dbang rdor phreng dang bka' 'gyur ro cog gi lung mnos/ bco brgyad la chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan chen mai tri dharma sya sa mu dra'i drung du tshigs gsum rim can gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa blangs/ gzhan yang paṇa chen rin po che'i bka' rtsom mang po'i dbang lung zhus/ de yi phyi lo yang ri'i 'dus tshogs dang lhan cig tu mdo khams phyogs kyi dar rtse mdo bar phyin/ chos dang zang zing gi 'brel ba bzhag lo gsum nas slar log ste sgar gyi khur me 'brug hor zla bcu gnyis par sprad de dben par gnas so// kho bo dharma kīrti yang*// shākya'i bstan la tshangs par spyod// mnyam med skyob pa'i ring lugs 'dzin// 'gro la bzang ngan 'brel ba 'jog /ces so// da lta'i tshul brjod pa ste sum cu pa'o// 31 slar ma 'ongs par 'byung 'gyur ni/ lus 'dis spra zhes bya ba'i brag nas chos gter zhig dang gter sgrom nas zab chos kyi 'phro pustaka gnyis yod pa rten 'brel 'dzoms pas thon na dang*/ gal srid dus dbang gis slob ma dam nyams kyi grib sogs kyis mi thon zhing bar gcod yong ba bstan yod pas de yi dbang du song na/ da dung skyu ra'i gdung 'di nyid las nga rang nas rtsis pa'i zhal ngo bdun song ba'i rjes su sbrul lo pa chos rje don grub grags pa chos kyi 'bangs zhes bya bar skyes nas zab gter rnams 'byin pa'i 'dun pa yang yod do// dus dbang rten 'brel ma 'grig na// zhal ngo bdun rgyud mtha' ma ru// gter ston lus kyis gter 'byin mkhan// don grub grags pa chos kyi 'bangs// zhes so// 32 de nas stod lung phyogs su sngags 'chang rta lo pa bdud 'dul grags pa zhes bya bar skyes nas tshe'i skor pustaka bdun tsam dang tshe'i ril bu sogs 'byin par 'gyur ro// bdud 'dul grags pa zhes bya ba// mtshan dkar ldan pa'i rigs sngags 'chang*// las smon ldan la 'chi med kyi// dngos grub ster la the tshom med// ces so//

33 de'i 'og tu rgya gar byang gling du paṇḍi ta sūrdza tsitta zhes bya bar skyes nas gzhung lugs rab 'byams la mkhas pa zhig gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba cher byed cing tshe 'pho bar 'gyur ro// rgya gar byang gling paṇḍi ta// blo chen sūrdza tsitta zhes// thams cad yod smra'i dge slong de// dus mtha'i thub bstan gsal byed yin// zhes so// 34 de 'og mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba klong yangs kyi spyan sngar byang chub sems dpa' bzhin bzang zla ba'i byin zhes bya bar gyur nas bka'i sdud pa por gyur pa 'di yang nyi ma las 'od zer dang chu las zegs ma 'byung ba dang mtshungs so/ /mngon dga'i zhing gi ston pa'i drung*// rgyal sras zla ba'i bzhin bzang yang*// nyi ma'i zer dang rgya mtsho'i rlabs// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i rol rtsed do// zhes so// 35 yang ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus su yang byang chub sems dpa' blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba can zhes bya bar 'gyur zhing dri ba la lan ldon pa'i tshul gyis dam pa'i chos 'dzin par byed do// rgyal bar gyur kyang rgyal sras tshul// chos kun chub kyang chos zhu'i tshul// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i snang ngo ru// mtha' yas sprul pa'i zlos gar bsgyur// zhes so// 36 mthar thug byang chub snying por bzhugs pa'i tshul yang ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas dgu pa me tog ces bya ba ste mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul rmad du byung ba'i gdul bya mtha' dag rigs can gsum gyi sar 'god par byed do// skal bzang dgu pa me tog ces bya ba// yab yum rigs gdung sras dang rim 'gro ba// mchog zung 'dus pa 'od dang sku tshe'i tshad// sku gdung bstan pa la sogs cho 'phrul rnams// rgyal sras rnams kyis gzhan gyi yul min no// zhes so// de ltar 'das pa'i skyes rabs nyer dgu ma 'ongs par 'byung 'gyur lnga| |da lta ba dang mthar thug 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul rnams bsdoms pa'i sum cu so drug go/

'di ni che long tsam zhig ste// snga phyi go rim dang dus mtshungs sogs sgrig pa zhig dgos rgyur 'dug kyang gong 'og snga phyi dang tshig gi rgyan dang sdeb sbyor sogs dor nas/ tshig nyung go bder bkod pa yin la/ 'dir ma 'thus pa kha shas yod kyang 'di'i skyes rabs re gnyis kyis mtshon nus pa yod pas re zhig gsal bar ma bris pa'ang mkhyen ldan dag gis dgongs 'tshal/ 'dir smras pa/ rang gi skyes rabs dran snang 'khrul pa'i yid// drang por bzung nas dad ldan slob ma 'gas// yang nas yang du bka' nan che ba'i ngor// yi ge'i lam du bkod la spro ba 'phel// deng sang dus kyi dbang gis mi rnams kyang*// dang po slob mar brdzus nas slob dpon slu// chos kun lam srol log par 'chad pa yi// bla ma mthong yang de nyid mi spang zhing*// dam chos tshul bzhin ston pa'i bshes gnyen la'ang*// gus pas 'tshol zhing tshul bzhin bsten pa nyung*// bdag gi skyes rabs 'khrul snang dran tshul rnams// rdzun du smras pa 'di la drang po ru// ji bzhin 'dzin pa'i blo gros rgyas phyir du// 'di rnams nges don lhug pa nyid du ste// nyams mtshar bzhad gad mdzad pa'i skye bo rnams// tshul 'di mthong tshe nyams dga'i rgyu ru mdzod// log par gshe ba'i dam med skyes bu rnams// 'di don gshe bkur sgro 'dogs rten du mdzod// chos rnams thams cad 'dun par rag las pas// zol zog drang por bzung na drang don te// nges don bden par bsam na nges par 'gyur// long gtam 'chal bar bzung na de bzhin no// de bas rang rang gang 'dod tshul 'di sgrubs// 'jam snyan don ldan tshig gi srad bu la// skyes rabs padma'i phreng ba tshar du sbrel// bar bar tshigs bcad rgyan gyi mtshar mtshar can// shes ldan sgeg 'chang dga' ba'i mgul rgyan mdzod// kho bo dharma kīrti yis// 'gro drug gnas su 'khor ba yi// snang tshul dran pa su yis langs| |'on kyang 'gru rgyal rigs 'di la// shes rab rdo rje rin chen dang*// a kā sha dang dharma'i ming*// lan lnga skyes pa rten 'brel dbang*// da dung slar yang skye tshul gcig

/da lta'i rten 'brel mthu min nam// yang dag dag pa'i gnas der yang yang brten pa yi// chos 'dul 'dul mngon mngon sum 'chad pa'i shes ldan gang*// rnam dpyod spyod gtsang gtsang sbra'i brtul zhugs can// smra mkhas mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob 'dod su gang zhig /thub bstan bstan pa mchog 'di'i lam srol bzung dang kye// zhes rang gi skyes rabs dran snang sngon chad kha yar yod pa 'thor ba 'dug pa dang gzhan dran snang phran bus kyang kha bskang ba 'di/ shes rab kyi blo can bla ma dro skyid kyis nan cher bskul ba la brten nas/ dpal shākya mchog ldan gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa/ shākya'i dge slong chos smra ba'i lo tsā ba bidyā dha ra dharma sya kīrti karma bi dza ya se na zhes bya bas/ dmar ser can gyi lo nag pa zla ba ston pa lhums su zhugs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ dus chen gsum 'dzoms pa'i nyer bdun snga dro'i cha la gzhu spro lung gi lcang lo can du mgyogs par bris pa'o// //maṅga lam//
